title: Adding/editing a provisioning repository or connection type touches 3 places
answers: What do I need to change to add a new repository type (e.g. Bitbucket)?
I added a field to the Repository config, what else needs updating?
Why is my new repository type not validating or building?
body:
Adding a new repository (or connection) type requires all three: (1) implement the Extra interface (Type/Build/Mutate/Validate) — apps/provisioning/pkg/repository/factory.go (mirrored in apps/provisioning/pkg/connection/factory.go); (2) add the config schema to apps/provisioning/kinds/repository.cue (or kinds/connection.cue); (3) register the enabled type + Extra at wiring time in the main module — pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/extras/register.go and pkg/server/wire_core.go. Missing one leaves the type unable to validate, build, or schema-round-trip.
Editing existing Repository/Connection fields (CUE-authored) requires editing the .cue file then running the app-sdk generator (apps/provisioning/Makefile generate target) to refresh pkg/apis/.../zz_generated.* and pkg/generated/** (clientset/informers/listers/applyconfiguration).
applies: Applies when adding a new repository/connection backend type or adding/editing fields on Repository/Connection. Does NOT apply to Job/HistoricJob/health/settings types, which are hand-written Go (see separate codegen-pipeline note).
